Params: Within the stream of flowing characters, a distant lifetime unfolds before her eyes.
The realization hits her at last. Beneath this nightmare of a body, beneath the grip of another's control... is her friend.
That tiny potted plant with its little mechanical claws, always scampering about, returned to this shell without a second thought. It came back to guard the only precious thing she had left.
It is no longer the little companion who once cast holograms that answers her now. Only a heartbeat, rapid and urgent, pounding back at her.
These long, sprawling memories are inscribed with a single name: Cordelia.
Across the vast ocean of time that separates them, Karenina's gaze finally finds the young woman who once held her in her arms, closer to her now than ever before.
This is also the journal of the "child" she once loved.
The "Lear Mannan" series was a line of marine engineering robots developed by the Transatlantic Economic Community for various ocean operations, their design modeled on the body of the Atlantic crab.
The Mannan M-1A was a specialized variant within the series.

This unit, dispatched to the Mid-Atlantic Ridge to construct an undersea database, also carried the duty of guarding the "Lighthouse," Mirage Island. That is why, after the disaster, it has remained here, bearing the island on its back alone.
In the vast, endless deep, it never once considered its own future.
It never even needed to speak to anyone.
Long-term station: Maintain and guard this lighthouse node. Executing.
Ocean current intensity within standard parameters.

Mannan M-1A, your logic circuits told you no action was needed, but you sent this up to me anyway. You know what that means? Your algorithm training's paying off. Your processing model is evolving.
Of course it's a good thing. In human terms... you're growing.
I'm gonna grant you higher processing privileges, okay? Now, what should I call you? Do you have a name?
A designation's not really a name... I mean, that's just a human perspective. If you like your designation, that works too... though it'd feel a little strange for me to say.
I don't like it. I don't dislike it. I don't understand the difference.
Are you saying... I need a name so that I can answer when you call me?

It did not know that every human who might have answered was already gone, that its birthplace had been destroyed.
